A '''House Nalju encampment''' was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Serenno/Legends|Serenno]] and led by an [[Unidentified House Nalju heir|heir]] of [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Unidentified House Nalju count|Nalju]].<ref name="FH" />

{{RPGseed}}
During their investigation in Nalju territory, a group of [[Colonist/Legends|colonists]] hired to locate a missing [[Unidentified House Demici heir|heir]] to [[House Demici/Legends|House Demici]] by [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Unidentified House Demici count|Demici]] were captured and accused of espionage and brought to the encampment. Young Nalju claimed that he was investigating a sighting of [[Noble Guard|House Demici Noble Guard]] and that he would gladly escort the Demici heir home if he found him, in order to avoid war between their houses.<ref name="FH" />

In the middle of the night, the House Demici Noble Guardsmen [[Raid on a House Nalju encampment|attacked]] the encampment, then stunned and abducted the heir to House Nalju into the forest.<ref name="FH" />
{{Endgame}}
